problem.title: Add Two Numbers II
problem.problemStatement: You are given two non-empty linked lists representing two non-negative integers. The digits are stored in forward order, with the most significant digit appearing first. Add the two numbers and return the result as a linked list in forward order. You may not modify the input lists.
problem.input: First linked list Second linked list
problem.output: The linked list representing the sum.
problem.constraints: Number of nodes in each list is in the range [1, 100] 0 <= node.value <= 9
